name: make_api_request
title: Make an AudD API request

result.description: endpoint-specific result payload (object, array, or null)

description: Calls the AudD API (api.audd.io) as this account - music recognition, lyrics, streams management, callbacks, etc. Uses the account plan quota exactly like a direct API call. For repeated or programmatic use, PREFER get_api_token and call https://api.audd.io/ directly from your own code/script - that is more efficient and reliable than routing every call through this tool; use make_api_request for one-off or interactive calls. Read get_api_docs first for endpoints and parameters. Audio must be passed by URL (e.g. params.url); binary file upload is not possible through this tool.

params.description: Request parameters as key-value strings, e.g. {"url": "https://example.com/a.mp3", "return": "spotify,apple_music"} (api_token is added automatically)

path.description: API path, default the main endpoint "/". E.g. "setCallbackUrl"

name: get_api_docs
title: Get AudD API documentation
description: Returns the official AudD API documentation (markdown). Topics: "api" (main endpoint: recognition, parameters), "streams" (continuous stream recognition and stream management), "enterprise", "file-upload".

name: get_account_status
title: Get account status
description: Current AudD plan, subscription status (active/trial/lapsed), paid-until date, bonus requests, and auto-renew setting.

name: get_usage_stats
title: Get usage statistics
description: API usage statistics (aggregate daily request counts only): current billing-cycle total, allowance, remaining, and per-day counts. Optional "days" returns the last N days instead of the current cycle.

days.description: Return daily stats for the last N days instead of the current billing cycle

name: get_billing_history
title: Get billing history
description: Recent payments on the account: subscriptions, renewals, extra-request settles, bonus purchases; amount, paid status, dates.

name: get_amount_owed
title: Get amount currently owed
description: Settle-aware calculation of over-allowance usage accrued this cycle and the amount (in cents) it will cost at the next renewal or settle.

name: get_api_token
title: Get the AudD api_token
description: Returns the account api_token used to call api.audd.io. This is the preferred way to build an integration: save the token and call the API directly from your script rather than proxying each call through make_api_request. Sensitive: only available when the user granted the token:read scope.

name: buy_bonus_requests
title: Create a payment link for extra requests
description: Creates a Stripe-backed payment link for buying N extra API requests (multiples of 1000). The link must be opened and approved by the account owner in a browser - this tool never charges a card by itself.

name: get_profile
title: Get account profile
description: The account email address and the connected sign-in methods (Google, GitHub, email, Telegram, ...).

name: list_plans
title: List subscription plans
description: The publicly available AudD subscription plans with pricing and included requests. Use the "plan" value with subscribe_to_plan.

name: subscribe_to_plan
title: Create a subscription payment link
description: Creates a Stripe-backed payment link to subscribe to (or switch to) a plan from list_plans. The link must be opened and approved by the account owner in a browser - this tool never charges a card by itself.

plan.description: Plan identifier from list_plans (e.g. indie_plan_outside, startup_plan, pro_plan)

name: create_renewal_payment
title: Create a subscription renewal payment link
description: Creates a Stripe-backed payment link to renew the subscription (including any owed extras). The link must be opened and approved by the account owner in a browser - this tool never charges a card by itself.
